levels.title: CTF service access
levels.cloud_content:
# CTF service lab

SSH/console account: `user-access`. Your organizer gives your team password. Per-service web logins and URLs are in `~/lab-addresses.txt` on your VM.

- team01 identity page: http://10.80.0.11/
  - ServiceDesk round 1: http://10.80.0.11:8080/
  - ServiceDesk round 2: http://10.80.0.11:8081/
- team02 identity page: http://10.80.0.12/
  - ServiceDesk round 1: http://10.80.0.12:8080/
  - ServiceDesk round 2: http://10.80.0.12:8081/
- team03 identity page: http://10.80.0.13/
  - ServiceDesk round 1: http://10.80.0.13:8080/
  - ServiceDesk round 2: http://10.80.0.13:8081/
- team04 identity page: http://10.80.0.14/
  - ServiceDesk round 1: http://10.80.0.14:8080/
  - ServiceDesk round 2: http://10.80.0.14:8081/

New connections from attacker VMs to the shared server 10.80.0.20 are blocked. The router is 10.80.0.1.

For external access, the organizer runs Configure-Deployment.ps1 after allocation and publishes its generated gateway URLs. SLA is measured by an external checker: 2 rounds, 120 seconds/tick. Service vulnerability_count is expected metadata; these two demo instances do not implement five separate vulnerabilities.

Enter `finish-idor-lab` when done.
